headline: Finnish and European health technology is active, with Oura's postponed US IPO, Horizon Europe 2027 calls open and the MDR/IVDR revision still in Parliament, but no reliable European market-size figure was found.
outlook_reason: Capital, public funding and a possible lighter MDR regime support commercialisation, though regulatory timing and IPO-market volatility remain uncertain.

signals.title: Oura postpones US IPO
signals.detail: Oura set terms (50 million shares at USD 40-44, valuation about USD 15.6 billion, Nasdaq ticker OURA) but a BusinessDay headline of 29 Sept reports it postponed the listing. I saw only the headline, not the article text, so the reason and any new date are unconfirmed.

signals.title: European Parliament SANT draft report on MDR/IVDR revision
signals.detail: The rapporteur's draft report has over 130 amendments. IMCO has published a draft opinion. A Parliament vote is forecast for Q1 2027 (secondary source). I found no Council general approach.

signals.title: Horizon Europe HLTH 2027 calls open
signals.detail: Calls include point-of-care diagnostics, AI biomarkers, disabilities and independent living, and virtual human twins.
